common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: Nothing up next. Add songs with /play.

added.title: Added to the queue
added.truncated: The list was cut to fit the queue limit.

notice.paused_empty: Everyone left {channel}, so the music is paused. The queue will be deleted {time} unless someone joins.
notice.queue_deleted: Nobody came back to {channel}. The queue was deleted.
notice.resumed_restart: Lynx restarted. Playback resumed in {channel} with {track}.
notice.too_many_failures: Several tracks in a row could not be played, so playback in {channel} stopped.
notice.disconnected: Lynx was disconnected from {channel}. The queue was deleted.

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.truncated: Open the panel to read the full lyrics.
lyrics.not_found: No lyrics found for that song.
lyrics.nothing: Nothing is playing. Use /lyrics with a song name.

error.guild_only: This command only works in a server.
error.no_player: Nothing is playing in your voice channel.
error.no_permission: You don't have permission to do that here.
error.dj_only: Only DJs and managers can do that in this server.
error.no_results: Nothing was found for that search.
error.all_busy: All Lynx bots in this server are busy in other voice channels. Invite another one to play here at the same time.
error.no_more_bots: All Lynx bots are busy in other voice channels of this server, and there are no more bots to add.
error.cannot_connect: Lynx cannot join or speak in {channel}. Check the channel permissions.
error.join_failed: Could not connect to the voice channel. Please try again.
error.expired: These buttons have expired. Use /queue again.
error.restarting: Lynx is restarting. Try again in a moment.
error.spotify_disabled: Spotify links are not enabled on this bot.
error.timeout: The source took too long to answer. Please try again.
error.main_missing: Add the main Lynx bot to this server to use this.
error.history_off: Your listening history is turned off. Turn it on in the panel (Privacy) to use Like, Dislike and the AI radio.

reply.already_voted: You already voted to skip this song ({current} of {required}).
reply.stopped: Stopped the music and left the channel.

node.notice: This bot is a Lynx voice node: it only plays music together with the main Lynx bot. Add the main bot to use Lynx in this server.

play.description: Play a song, a playlist or a search

skip.description: Skip the current song (or vote to skip)

stop.description: Stop the music, clear the queue and leave

remove.description: Remove a song from the queue

move.description: Move a song in the queue

skipto.description: Jump to a position in the queue, dropping the songs before it

volume.value: Volume from 0 to 200 (100 is the original)

lyrics.description: Show the lyrics of the current song or of a search
